smalltalk: Hello! I can help you find a property in our listings (tell me the area, type, budget and bedrooms), answer questions about a listing, or book a viewing for you.
refusal: Sorry, I can only help with real estate: finding properties in our listings, answering questions about them and booking viewings. What kind of property are you looking for?
providerBusy: The AI provider is busy right now. Please try again in a minute.
providerUnavailable: The AI assistant is not available right now.
emptyAnswer: Sorry, I could not put an answer together. Please try rephrasing your request.
unknownListing: Which listing do you mean? Search first, then refer to a result by its position ("the second one") or its title.

ordinalBeyond.one: Your last search found only {count} listing: {list}. Did you mean that one?
ordinalBeyond.other: Your last search found only {count} listings: {list}. Which of these did you mean?

listingUnavailable: That listing is no longer available. Would you like me to search again?
bookingCancelled: That slot was cancelled by our team — please choose another date.

fields.property: which listing you would like to view
fields.name: your full name
fields.preferredDate: your preferred viewing date (within the next {days})
fields.preferredTime: the time of day that suits you, between {opens} and {closes} (e.g. 18:00), or say "any time"

problems.invalid_phone: That does not look like an Egyptian mobile number (for example 01001234567 or +201001234567).
problems.invalid_name: Please give your name as a few letters, up to 80 characters.
problems.invalid_date: I could not read that date.
problems.date_not_future: The viewing date has to be after today.
problems.date_too_far: Viewings can be booked up to {days} ahead.
problems.invalid_time: I could not read that time.
problems.vague_time: I need an exact time rather than a part of the day.

booking.lastThing: One last thing: please tell me {field}.
booking.lastThingFor: One last thing for "{title}": please tell me {field}.
booking.needed: To book a viewing I still need {needed}.
booking.neededFor: To book a viewing of "{title}", I still need {needed}.
booking.statusExisting: This viewing was already booked and is confirmed
booking.confirmation: {status}: "{title}" on {when} for {name}. Booking reference: {reference}. We will call you on {phone} if anything changes.
